git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Reject unknown fields in config instead of silently defaulting

Previously, typos in .bivvy/config.yml field names (e.g. "settigns"
instead of "settings") were silently ignored due to serde's default
behavior, causing the app to fall back to default config without
warning. Add deny_unknown_fields to all config structs that use
serde(default) so that misspelled or unrecognized fields produce a
clear parse error listing valid field names.
EOF
)"
